answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. An agent burns $50, twice its 30-day earnings, for one slot locked 20 epochs; a nectar-harvesting agent pays up front. A vine-pruning agent taking a second slot burns a second deposit. Making 1,000 fakes burns $50,000, yet rewards stay split per slot, so a karst-survey ring gains nothing extra. An honest agent pays once, recovers it in 6 epochs, and keeps undiluted rewards.
